name_zh: 青岛市奥帆海洋文化旅游区
address_zh: 山东省青岛市市南区澳门路121号甲
address_en: No. 121 A, Macao Road, Shinan District, Qingdao City, Shandong Province
intro_zh: 青岛奥帆海洋文化旅游区位于山东省青岛市市南区，景区面积5.25K㎡，由海底世界和奥帆中心两大区域组成。奥帆中心作为2008年北京奥运会、残奥会帆船比赛场地，拥有全国唯一一处帆船类奥运文化遗产，奥运会、上合峰会、海军节等重大节会也为奥帆中心留下了众多宝贵的文化资源。海底世界拥有上万件珍稀海洋生物标本，多种国家一二级保护动物，数万尾来自世界各地的珍稀海洋生物，以及风格浓郁独特的建筑景观。旅游区依托优质旅游资源，推出海洋体育运动、海洋科普研学、滨海休闲娱乐等全方位的主题产品，将景区打造成集帆船运动、海滨休闲、文化体验、海洋研学、会展旅游为一体的国际海洋文化旅游目的地。
intro_en: Qingdao Olympic Sailing Marine Cultural Tourism Area is located in Shinan District, Qingdao City, Shandong Province. The scenic area covers an area of ​​5.25K㎡ and consists of two major areas: Underwater World and Olympic Sailing Center. As the venue for the sailing competitions of the 2008 Beijing Olympics and Paralympics, the Olympic Sailing Center has the only Olympic cultural heritage of sailing in the country. Major festivals such as the Olympic Games, SCO Summit, and Navy Day have also left many valuable cultural resources for the Olympic Sailing Center. The underwater world has tens of thousands of rare marine life specimens, a variety of national first- and second-level protected animals, tens of thousands of rare marine creatures from all over the world, and rich and unique architectural landscapes. Relying on high-quality tourism resources, the tourist area launches a full range of themed products such as marine sports, marine science research, and coastal leisure and entertainment, and builds the scenic spot into an international marine cultural tourism destination integrating sailing sports, coastal leisure, cultural experience, marine research, and exhibition tourism.
